description: This file sets up a conversational bot using Pipecat framework, integrating speech processing, language models, and GitHub MCP services. It defines transport parameters, initializes services, and manages a pipeline for handling WebRTC calls with GitHub-related functionalities.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Represents the sequence of processing steps for the bot.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Encapsulates the pipeline, its parameters, and timeout settings.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Manages execution of the pipeline, handling signals and running tasks.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Holds context information for the language model interactions.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Pairs user and assistant aggregators with shared context.

classes.name: FastAPIWebsocketParams
classes.description: Parameters for WebSocket transport via FastAPI.

methods.name: run_bot
methods.description: Sets up and runs the bot pipeline with given transport and runner arguments.

methods.name: bot
methods.description: Main entry point for the bot, initializes transport and starts the bot process.
